result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but several visual defects appear: a meaningless '-0%' discount badge, hard-clipped restaurant name text, inconsistent favorite-button styling, and content cut off by the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The promotional badge on the pizza card reads '-0%', which is a meaningless/zero discount and looks like a data or formatting bug.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0, or display the real percentage.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the name 'Trattoria Piccol' hard-clipped at the screen edge with no ellipsis, and the card image is also abruptly cut, making it unclear the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow ellipsis to restaurant names and add a peek/padding offset so partially visible cards clearly signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white circle with dark outline on the ramen card, dark circle with white outline on the pizza card.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite button treatment (e.g., translucent dark circle with white icon) across all cards.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom tab bar with no visible title or metadata, leaving an incomplete-looking viewport bottom.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the tab bar height to the scroll container so cards can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Category chip row is cut off mid-chip at the right edge and the notification bell dot has no textual indication, so unread state and additional filters may be missed by some users.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/gradient or arrow affordance to the chip row and provide an accessible label/count for the notification indicator.
